name: Wee Hur Holdings Ltd.
summary: Wee Hur Holdings Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in general building and civil engineering construction business in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Australia. It operates through Property, Building Construction, Fund Management, Alternative Investment, and PBSA Operation segments. The Property segment develops and sells residential and industrial properties; and mixed-use properties and residential land subdivision, as well as builds and operates workers' dormitories; and purpose-built student accommodation for local and foreign students.
